# Quaternius Farmer Model

`farmer.glb` is a trimmed Quaternius farmer model taken from the public
`AleDev11/FindTheNeedle-Coop-Mod` repository.

Source repository:
https://github.com/AleDev11/FindTheNeedle-Coop-Mod

The repository README credits the farmer model as coming from Quaternius'
Ultimate Modular Men Pack under CC0.

Original Quaternius pack:
https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimatemodularcharacters.html
